question: Union Cabinet approves Research Development and Innovation Scheme. What is the total outlay for the RDI Scheme?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**₹1 lakh crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Union Cabinet approves Research Development and Innovation Scheme.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **Union Cabinet**, led by **PM Narendra Modi**, has approved the **Research Development and Innovation (RDI) Scheme.**

 
 
• 
 
Announced by **Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw**, the scheme has a budget of **₹1 lakh crore**.

 
 
• 
 
Main aim: Encourage the **private sector** to scale up **R&D and innovation** in **sunrise domains** (emerging tech areas) and sectors important for **economic security** and **self-reliance**.

 
 
• 
 
It will fund **transformative projects** at **higher Technology Readiness Levels (TRL)**.

 
 
• 
 
The scheme will support the **acquisition of critical technologies** that are of **strategic importance**.

 
 
• 
 
A **Deep-Tech Fund of Funds** will be created under this scheme.

 
 
• 
 
The **Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF)**, chaired by the **Prime Minister**, will provide **strategic direction**.
